cases.name: english
cases.text: The old observatory sat on a wind-cut ridge above the valley. Every dusk the keeper lit a small lamp, opened the dome, and swept the floor so the gears would not grind. She had counted meteors since she was twelve, writing each streak in a cloth-bound ledger: time, color, and whether it left a trail. Tonight the sky was so clear that the river below held a second copy of the Milky Way. She paused, not to wish, but to measure. Science, she thought, is a kind of patience that still leaves room for wonder.

cases.name: python
cases.text:
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Iterable, List

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Node:
    value: int
    children: tuple['Node', ...] = ()

def walk(root: Node) -> List[int]:
    out: List[int] = []
    stack = [root]
    while stack:
        node = stack.pop()
        out.append(node.value)
        stack.extend(reversed(node.children))
    return out

def pairwise_sums(xs: Iterable[int]) -> List[int]:
    xs = list(xs)
    return [a + b for a, b in zip(xs, xs[1:])]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    tree = Node(1, (Node(2), Node(3, (Node(4), Node(5)))))
    print(walk(tree))
    print(pairwise_sums(range(8)))

cases.name: chinese
cases.text: 江南的梅雨季节，青石巷被洗得发亮。老茶馆里，一位匠人一边修缮算盘，一边讲述河对岸书院的旧事。他说做学问像推舟：看起来在走直线，其实要顺着水流的回旋。桌上放着半卷未完成的诗稿，墨迹未干，窗外有人撑着油纸伞走过，脚步轻得几乎听不见。我们问他何为根基，他只答：先把每个字读准，再把每件事做完。

cases.name: technical
cases.text:
Section 1. Transformer language models map a sequence of tokens to contextual representations using stacked residual blocks. Each block applies multi-head self-attention, then a position-wise feed-forward network with a gated linear unit. Grouped-query attention reduces the key-value cache by sharing a small number of key and value heads across many query heads. Nanbeige4.3-33B-Base uses fifty-six query heads and eight key-value heads, each of dimension one hundred twenty-eight. Rotary position embeddings rotate adjacent pairs of dimensions by an angle that grows with token position. The frequency of pair i is theta to the power of minus two i over the rotary dimension, with theta equal to ten million in this checkpoint. The feed-forward layer is SwiGLU: a SiLU-gated projection multiplied by an up-projection, then a down-projection back to the hidden size of 7168. The intermediate width is 22016. Layer norms are RMSNorm with epsilon 1e-5. Quantized inference stores most tensors in K-quants. Q4_K_M keeps attention and feed-forward weights in 4-bit super-blocks with a few Q6_K tensors for the output path, while RMSNorm parameters stay in float32. Prefill evaluates the prompt as a batch matrix multiply; decode then consumes one token per step from the KV cache. A working prompt cache should reuse the prefix of a longer request so the second call does not recompute every layer. Correctness against llama.cpp is measured greedily: temperature zero, top_k one, sixty-four generated tokens. Token ids must match, not just decoded strings, because different piece boundaries can print the same text. The tokenizer is SentencePiece. Spaces become U+2581, a dummy prefix is inserted after special tokens including the beginning of the prompt, leftover bytes become tokens of the form <0xNN>, and BOS id 1 is prepended when add_bos is true.

Implementation notes: hidden_size=7168, num_layers=52, vocab_size=166912, context_length=131072, rope_dim=128.
